title: UCS DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local UCS direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body, detached string destination, and detached handle destination while preserving aliasing and the existing version-specific UCS coordinate, orthographic-option, common-handle, xref, base-UCS, and named-UCS encoding. Publish only after each staged buffer remains healthy.

control.profile: Locally generated UCS with two reactors, extension dictionary, nondefault origin/axes/elevation, two orthographic options, and xref/base/named UCS handles.
control.tested_route: Protected direct encodeDwg exposed through a test-only derived probe
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.result: The allocation control reports all seven layouts passing rollback/retry across 128 offsets. All six focused CTests passed, including the original-source UCS/view cohort.

limits: Generated local transaction evidence only; it does not establish additional UCS wire layouts or producer support profiles.
The tests verify local output invariants and existing bounded source behavior, not native CAD acceptance or whole-document qualification.
Source/reference graph closure beyond the exercised UCS cases remains open.
